content: Nainu-Imaklegosulid-Birga
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga Sinaí-yargi sunmakded, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Bab-Jehová bemarga-yar-uknaidse be ambikudapmalale, Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega a-yargi birgagwen nainu obunnonai guoed.
” ’Birganergwa (6) bemar be-nainumargi ibmar digmaloed. Birganergwa (6) be-uva-dub be nue sike-sike imakmaloed, degi, e-san be weemarbaloed.
Birgagugledgindina (7), Bab-Jehová-nug-odummogega, bar be nainugi arbaosurmalad. A-birgagine, be-nainugi be ibmar-digosulid, deginbali, be-uva-dub be sike-sike imakosurbalid.
Be-nainugi wargwengi ibmar-gwag-ainidagoedi be bela weosulid, deginbali, uva be digsasulid wargwengi-sanmakdagoedi be bela weosurbalid. Birgagwen nainugi be arbaosulid.
Degi-inigwele, a-birgagi nainugi bela ibmar-sanmakoedi bemarga unniguar gunnega guoed. Be-mai-machered, be-mai-ome, dule-bega-arbaed, degi, Israel-dulesulid-be-yargi-gudiid sunna gunmarmogoed.
Deginbali, be-molimar-bebe-nikad, degi, ibdurganmar be-yargi-nikamalad we-ibmarmar-sanmakoedi, sunna gunmarmogoed.’ ”
Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga
Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Birgagugled, ilagugle (7) be ebisoed. A sogleged, birga-durbo-gakabakebakye (49).
Geb a-birga-nasadgine, nii-walagugled-ibambegi, isgued-osuloged-ibagi binnasuli gar-trompeta bela be-yalagi be ogoloed.

Weyobi, birga-durbo-gakambegidi (50), Bab-Jehováʼga birga-islidikidga be imakoed. A-birgagi, bela Israel-yargi Israel-dulemar maiga-gudiile, ollorgunonikoed. A-birga, bemarga Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgaga guoed. Degine, bemar na gannar e-nainu-e-nainu sumaloed, gannar na e-gwenadganse namaloed.
Birga-dulabo-gakambegid (50) bemarga Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgaga guoed. A-birgagi, bemar nainugi ibmar-digosurmalad, nainugi ibmar-ainioed be weosurmarbalid, degine, uva be weosurmarbalid.
Ar ade, a-birga, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgad. A-birgade bemarga birga-islidikidid. A-birgagi unnila ibmar-e-itolegedba-ainied-sanmakoedi be gunmaloed.
” ’Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi bela bemar na gannar e-nainu-e-nainuse namaloed.
” ’Dule-baidga be nainu manigi-uksadibe, dule-baidse be nainu-baksadibe, melle bemar be-gwenadgan mesagwar imako.
Igi birga Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga-napi, a-birga-napiwilub be dule-baidse nainu bakoed. Dule-nainu-ukoeddi, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga-napiwilub nainu gargegu ukoed.

” ’Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga amba undar napile, mani-dummad nainu be ukoed. Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga ichee napile, adi, nainu mani-bipii be ukoed, ar ade, ibmar-welegoedba, we-nainu gargegu be ukoed.
” ’Melle be dule-baid mesagwar imako. Bur be-Bab-Dummad be dobee nanadii gumalo, ar ade, ani an bemar-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued.’ ”
Igar-maidba-nanamalad-igar

Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Bab-Jehová-e-igar-bemarga-uksadba be nanamarsun, Bab-Jehová-Igar-Mamaidba be damarsun. A-sogedba bemar gudii gumarsun. Geb degine, bemar bogidik gudii gumaloed.
Nainu bemarga ibmar-osanmakoed. A-ibmarmar nue-immedik bemar gunmaloed, degine, a-yalagi, nue-bogidik bemar bukwa gumaloed.
” ’Ar bemar egisdamalodibe: ¿Ar wede birgagugledgi (7), ibi anmar gunmalosunna? Ar ade, ibmarde anmar digosurmalad, degine, anmar weosurmarbalid.
” ’Birganergwadgine (6) Bab-Jehová bemargi ise-nued binsamaloed. Bab-Jehová birgapaa-wilub nainugi ibmar-osanmakoed.
Birgabaabakgine (8), be ibmar-digmaloed. A-birgagine, ibmar-gwagmar-sabosmalad bemar gunmaloed. Birgabakebakse (9), ibmar-sabosad be gunmaloed. Geb a-birgagine, ibmar-sanmakded be gutemaloed.’ ”
Ibmar-gannar-obirileged-igar

Bab-Jehová, Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Dule-nainu-baksadi degisadegu egadga guosulid, ar ade, nainu Bab-Jehováʼgadid. Ar bemar unnila sikwas we-yargi gudimalad. Bemar we-yargi degisadegu gudiguosurmalad.
Degisoggu, bemar-nainu-baksamaladi, be wisgumalargebed, gannar-nainu-obirileged-igar bemarga maigu guoed.
” ’Be-gwenad mani-sate-gudele, na e-nainu uksale, e-gwenad-bur-walikagwad nainu-uklesad ega onononikoed.
” ’Dule ega e-anar nainu-onoged-satele, ar na dukin e-nainu-onogega, unniguar mani amisale,
nainu-uklesad-akar birga ebisoed. Geb Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga igi-napi, a-wilub mani bennukoed. Geb degine, we-nainu gannar na egadga gunonikoed.
Ar unniguar mani amissulile, dule ese nainu-baksadi we-nainu Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgase gani guoed. Geb agine, we-nainu Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi gannar e-ibedgadga guoed.
” ’Dule-gwensak neggwebur-sakdigar-siidyaba na e-neg manigi uksale, we-dule, sunna a-neg birgagwengi gannar obiroed. Ega birgagwen naguoed gannar neg-obiregar.
Birgagwengi we-neg obiridsulile, neggwebur-sakdigar-siidyaba we-neg-siidi, dule-neg-baksadgadga, degi, e-wagangadga degisadegu guoed. Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi we-neg e-ibedga bar uklegosulid.
” ’Neggwebur-sakdigarsulidgi negmar-siidi nainuyob guoed. A-negmardi sunna gannar obirilegoed, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi a-nega e-ibedga uklegoed.
” ’Levita-dulemardi e-neggweburmargi e-neg-siidi manigi uksale, sunna gannar obire guoed.

Dule-gwensak Levita-dulemar-neggweburgi Levita-dulese neg baksale, we-dule, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi gannar ega neg maniginsuli ukoed. Ega gannar obiroed, ar ade, e-neggweburmargi-neg-bukwadi Israel-dulemar-abargi Levitaʼmarga uklesadid.
Levita-dulemar-e-gagan-nainumardi bipisaale manigi uklegosulid. Ar ade, we-gagan-nainu Levita-dulemargadga degisadegu guoed.
” ’Be-dule wilegedga gudele, bese danikile, be bendakoed. Be-neggi dule-neggwebur-baidginedyob gudii guoed.
We-dulegi, melle ega be mani-nug meso, degi, melle ei ibmar be sumarbalo. Suli, degisuli. Be-Bab-Dummad-dobee be nanamaloed. We-be-dule be-walik gudii guoed.
Deginbali, bese mani egichisale, egi mani onogegala, melle egi mani-obine be gao, degi, melle masgunned ega mani-obine be ukbalo.
Ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued. Ani an Canaán-yala bemarga ukega, Egipto-yargi bemar-onosad, adi, an be-Bab-Dummadga guegar.
” ’Be-dule be-walik-gudii wilegedga gudele, manigi bese na dukin ukdele, melle dule-mai-imaklegedyob be imako.
Nabir binsa bega dule-arbaedyob, Israel-dulesulid-be-walik-gudiidyob be imakoed. We-dule, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgase bega arbaoed.
Geb a-birgagine, e-mimmiganmala nabir be-neggi nodoed. Geb e-gwenadganse gannar naoed, na e-dadgan-nainu gannar egadga gunonikoed.
Deyob guoed, ar ade, Israel-dulemar anga-arbamalad-gumalad, ani an wemar Egipto-yargi onosad. A-ular, Israel-dulemala maiga-guega manigi uklegosurmalad.
Melle Israel-dulemar sabsuli-imakdii be gumalo. Suli, degisuli. Be-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanadii be gumaloed.
” ’Dulemar-be-yar-dikarba-mamaid, machereddibe, omedibe, amala sunna be-maiga gumaloed. Amala, machereddibe, omedibe be-maiga-gumalagala, manigi be bakmaloed.
Deginbali, Israel-dulesurmalad-bemar-abargi-mamaid, e-mimmigan-be-yargi-gwalulesmaladi, be-maiga-guegala, sunna manigi be bakmaloed, adi, bemargadga guegar.

Be burgwisale, we-be-maimala sunna be-mimmiganga be obemalad, adi, degisadegu be wagangadga guegar. Amala, degisadegu be-maiga gumaloed. Bemar, be-gwenadgandi, Israel-dulemardi, sabsuli gwen imakosurmalad.

” ’Israel-dulesulid bemar-abargi-maid mani-ibedga gudele, Israel-dule a-dikarba-maid wilegedga gudele, we-dule, dule-mani-ibed-e-maiga-guega na san-ukdele, igidibe, Israel-dulesulid-e-gwenadga na san-ukdele,
dule-na-san-uksad sunna gannar onoleged. E-gwenad-wargwen sunna manigi onogoed.
E-gilordibe, e-gilor-machidibe, a sunna manigi a-dule-onogoed. E-gwenad-walikagwad sunna onomogad. Ar e-sunnad sunna nabir na onogele, ar na dukin manigi onogodo.

Dule, degi, dule-mani-ibed na ebogwa itomaloed, birgabigwa-gusa dule-manigi-uklesa, degi, igi-birga, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga napi. Agine, itogoed, dule-wargwen-arbaed igi-mani bennuklesale, abali, mani-nasiklegoed, igi-manigi dule-onolegoe.
Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga amba ichesur-napile, a-wilub, uklesadgi-ollorguega mani-dummad bennukoed.
Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga ichenapile, itomaloed, a-birgamarde igi-mani-wilub gue. Geb ollorguega, a-wilub bennukoed.
We-dule, unnila dule-birgagwen-manigin-arbaedyob imaklegoed. We-dule nue be dakmaloed, melle dule-baksad sabsuli we-dule-imaked be imakmalo.
” ’We-dule Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birga-idu ollorgussulile, Gannar-Ibmar-Ukleged-Birgagi e-mimmiganmala ollorguoed.
” ’Israel-dulemar anga-arbamalad gumalad. We-Israel-dulemar, ani an Egipto-yargi onosad. Ani an be-Bab-Dummad-Jehová gued.’ ”
